sections.Profile:
The "Alpha 2001" pinball machine, produced by C.E.A. Electronics Corporation in 1977, is a single-player, solid-state game with a space fantasy theme. It features two flippers, three pop bumpers, and two slingshots. Notably, the artwork and design elements are derived from Gottlieb's 1976 "Target Alpha."

- Years made: 1977
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
